scripts.build: bun run schema:generate && tsc -p packages/cli && chmod +x packages/cli/dist/cli.js
scripts.validate: bun run schema:generate && bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run build
scripts.ui:serve: bun run --cwd packages/app build && bun run --cwd packages/app serve
scripts.web:build: bun run web:check && bun run --cwd web build
scripts.web:check: bun run schema:generate && git diff --exit-code docs && bun run --cwd web check && bun test web/src
scripts.web:preview: bun run --cwd web build && bun run --cwd web preview
